versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00098 If an expiry point contains actions to activate a Task and to set one or several Event (s) of the same Task , then the Operating System module shall process this Task activation before the related Event (s) are set. No further assumptions about the order for the processing of expiry points can be made.
